description: Scrape TikTok playlists and public collections by URL, numeric ID, profile URL or @username.

maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset rows across all targets, including status rows. Use 0 for no global limit.
maxItems.title: Max Rows (Global)

maxPlaylistsPerProfile.description: Maximum playlists to process for each profile or username target.
maxPlaylistsPerProfile.title: Max Playlists Per Profile

maxPostsPerPlaylist.description: Maximum videos to return from each playlist or collection. Set high enough to cover the full list.
maxPostsPerPlaylist.title: Max Videos Per Playlist

mode.description: Return playlist/collection metadata rows, video rows, or both.
mode.title: What to Return

playlistIds.description: Numeric TikTok playlist IDs (15–20 digits). If an ID belongs to a public collection, the collection route is tried automatically.
playlistIds.title: Playlist IDs

playlistUrls.description: Playlist URLs, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@natgeo/playlist/Cinematic-7509464647364283178. Collection URLs pasted here are detected automatically.
playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs

profileUrls.description: TikTok profile URLs. Every public playlist on each profile is discovered, up to the per-profile limit.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

usernames.description: TikTok handles with or without @. Every public playlist on each profile is discovered.
usernames.title: Usernames

title: TikTok Playlist & Collection Scraper Input
